title: Giants to sign RB Gregory Desrosiers off Chargers practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants to sign RB Gregory Desrosiers off Chargers practice squad
sources.description: The Giants will be without Tyrone Tracy for at least the next four games because of a hamstring injury and they'll pluck a player from another team to fill the opening on their active roster.
